{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
valid_sales = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute conversion rates within each customer segment, by channel
stratified = valid_sales.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment
diff_by_segment = stratified['email'] - stratified['paid_search']

# Compute total number of customers in each segment across both channels
segment_totals = valid_sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Compute weighted average of the differences
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment * segment_totals).sum() / segment_totals.sum()

# Extract and print each individual segment difference and the final weighted difference
loyal_diff = diff_by_segment['loyal']
new_diff = diff_by_segment['new']
returning_diff = diff_by_segment['returning']
final_diff = weighted_diff

# Print each value individually with precise formatting
print(f"{loyal_diff:.3f}")
print(f"{new_diff:.3f}")
print(f"{returning_diff:.3f}")
print(f"{final_diff:.3f}")"}
